questions.question_text: When two resistors of 6 Ω are connected in parallel, the effective resistance value in the circuit is
questions.answer: For two equal resistors in parallel, the effective resistance is R/2 = 6/2 = 3 Ω.

questions.question_text: The conduction for maximum power transfer in the circuit is the effective resistance of the circuit is equal to the
questions.answer: The condition for maximum power transfer requires that the internal resistance of the source must equal the load resistance.

questions.question_text: The power factor can be determined by the formula
questions.answer: Power factor is the cosine of the phase angle, which in an impedance triangle is given by the ratio of True Resistance (R) to Total Impedance (Z), hence R/Z.

questions.question_text: The line voltage is expressed in star connected network as
questions.answer: In a balanced three-phase star (Y) connection, the line voltage is equal to √3 times the phase voltage.

questions.question_text: When +ve terminal of the battery is connected P-type and -ve terminal to the N-type of PN junction diode, the bias applied
questions.answer: Connecting the positive terminal to the P-type (anode) and negative to the N-type (cathode) reduces the depletion region, which defines a forward-biased condition.

questions.question_text: To determine the input characteristics of CE configuration NPN transistor _______ is kept constant.
questions.answer: Input characteristics of a Common Emitter (CE) transistor are obtained by plotting base current (I_B) versus base-emitter voltage (V_{BE}) while maintaining a constant Collector-Emitter voltage (V_{CE}).

questions.question_text: The terminals of JFET are
questions.answer: A Junction Field Effect Transistor (JFET) possesses three terminals: Source, Drain, and Gate.

questions.question_text: The device that are designed to convert DC signal into AC signal are known as
questions.answer: An inverter is a power electronic device utilized to convert a Direct Current (DC) input into an Alternating Current (AC) output.

questions.question_text: The brushes in DC machine are made of
questions.answer: Brushes in DC machines are typically constructed using Carbon (or graphite) because of its self-lubricating properties and low wear coefficient.

questions.question_text: The transformer works on the principle of
questions.answer: Transformers function based on Faraday's law of mutual electromagnetic induction, allowing power transfer between magnetically coupled coils.

questions.question_text: The encoder in the servometer is used to determine the
questions.answer: An encoder is a critical feedback sensor in a servomotor system used directly to track the rotor's exact position and rotational speed.

questions.question_text: Slip-ring rotor is a type of rotor of
questions.answer: Three-phase induction motors come primarily in two rotor types: Squirrel-cage rotors and wound Slip-ring rotors.

questions.question_text: The torque which is always present in the instrument whether it is connected to the supply or not is
questions.answer: Controlling torque (provided by hairsprings or gravity weights) constantly acts on the pointer system to return it to zero, regardless of whether the instrument is energized.

questions.question_text: The eddy current produce the required damping torque opposing the motion of the moving coil in PMMC as per
questions.answer: According to Lenz's law, the direction of induced eddy currents is such that it opposes the physical motion (change in magnetic flux) that caused it, thus providing damping.

questions.question_text: The instrument which gives the storage of a digital waveform is
questions.answer: A Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO) converts analog signals to a digital format and stores them into memory, allowing continuous waveform observation.

questions.question_text: One example for active transducer is
questions.answer: A thermocouple acts as an active transducer because it self-generates an output voltage directly proportional to a temperature difference without requiring an external supply.

questions.question_text: The power factor in dc transmission system is
questions.answer: Because direct current (DC) has a frequency of 0 Hz, there is zero reactance in the steady state, meaning no reactive power is generated, keeping the power factor always at unity (1).

questions.question_text: The most commonly used material for the manufacture of insulator in power system is
questions.answer: Porcelain has excellent dielectric strength, mechanical robustness, and resistance to environmental elements, making it the most traditional and common material for high voltage insulators.

questions.question_text: An electrical safety device that has the capability to protect the circuit from excessive current is
questions.answer: A fuse is an essential safety device designed to automatically melt and break the circuit when excessive overcurrent flows through it.

questions.question_text: One example for renewable energy source is
questions.answer: Solar energy harnesses the power of the sun, which is naturally replenishing, qualifying it as a renewable energy resource.
